create_NSchools_model: create an NSchools probabilistic model with states, districts, and types for hierarchical Bayesian inference
define_sigma_state_random_variable: define a HalfCauchy-distributed sigma_state random variable for state-level variance in the NSchools model
define_beta_baseline_random_variable: define a StudentT-distributed beta_baseline random variable for the baseline effect in the NSchools model
convert_data_to_observations: convert an xarray Dataset to a dictionary mapping random variables to observed values for Bean Machine inference
extract_data_from_bm: extract MonteCarloSamples from Bean Machine and convert them into an xarray Dataset for PPLBench
